description: Presence of people and sky per photo of the quality set, the reference masks that give the labeled cells, and the regions of unreferenced instances. Read by make_label_grids.py.
coordinate_space: normalized image coordinates [0, 1]: [x0, y0, x1, y1], x right, y down

status_values.referenced: the class is in the photo and a reference mask gives its cells
status_values.present_unreferenced: the class is in the photo, but no reference mask exists; ignore_boxes cover it
status_values.uncertain: it is not clear from the photo whether the class is in it; ignore_boxes cover the candidate area
status_values.absent: the class is not in the photo

reference_rules.single_mask: <stem>__<prompt>__single0.png: the single-mask output of the E1 prompt (SAM 2.1 base plus, PyTorch); for a box prompt, the mask that the E1 overlay shows
reference_rules.best_multimask: <stem>__<prompt>__multi<i>.png with the highest predicted IoU (score_torch) in the E1 compare.json: the mask that the E1 overlay shows for one point
reference_rules.exclude: pixels of this reference are removed from the class reference

classification_method: By eye from the full photo (2026-10-20). The ignore boxes are generous: an ignored cell is only excluded from the prototypes and from the area under the ROC curve.
